summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, a foreign private issuer, as a routine submission of its annual consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025, with an independent auditor's report. The filing includes a statement of directors' responsibility, confirming the financial statements are prepared in accordance with Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change—is announced or referenced. The filing is purely a periodic financial reporting obligation under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. As such, it does not trigger any special-situations classification.
